subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Mutant
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Deviant.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"mutant"** means an organism or genetic feature that has undergone mutation, resulting in a deviation from the standard form. (उत्परिवर्तित)

 
 
• **Example: **The scientist studied the mutant strains of the virus to understand its changes.
 
 
 
• **"Deviant" **refers to something that deviates from the usual or accepted standards, especially in social or sexual behavior. (विचलित)
 
 
• **Example: **The artist's deviant style challenged the conventional norms of the art world.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Deviant.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Disabled **(विकलांग): Lacking one or more physical abilities.

 
 
• **Example:** The facility is equipped to accommodate disabled individuals.
 
 
 
• **Flawless **(निर्दोष): Without any imperfections.
 
 
• **Example: **Her performance in the inauguration was flawless.
 
 
 
• **Superhuman **(अलौकिक): Having exceptional abilities that go beyond those of a normal human being.
 
 
• **Example: **His superhuman strength amazed everyone at the competition.
